query: Is a broken windscreen covered by my car insurance?
ground_truth_answer: Yes. Comprehensive motor cover pays for repair or replacement of windscreens (clause KFZ-1001).

query: How much is the excess for windscreen replacement?
ground_truth_answer: The excess for glass damage is EUR 150 (clause KFZ-1001).

query: Do I pay an excess if the windscreen is only repaired?
ground_truth_answer: No. The EUR 150 excess is waived if the windscreen is repaired instead of replaced (clause KFZ-1001).

query: Does a glass claim change my no-claims class?
ground_truth_answer: No. Glass claims do not affect the no-claims class (clause KFZ-1005).

query: I hit a deer. Is the damage to my car covered?
ground_truth_answer: Yes. Comprehensive cover pays for collisions with animals of any kind (clause KFZ-1002).

query: By when must I report a collision with a wild boar to the police?
ground_truth_answer: Within 24 hours, to the police or the forest authority (clause KFZ-1002).

query: Is a collision with a cat covered or only with game animals?
ground_truth_answer: Animals of any kind are covered (clause KFZ-1002).

query: My car was stolen. When will I receive the money?
ground_truth_answer: The replacement value is paid if the car is not found within one month after the theft was reported to the police (clause KFZ-1003).

query: What do I have to hand over to the insurer after a car theft?
ground_truth_answer: All keys of the vehicle (clause KFZ-1003).

query: Which documents does a theft claim need?
ground_truth_answer: The policy number, a description, photos where possible and the police report number (clause CLM-3002).

query: Do I get a rental car while my car is repaired after an accident?
ground_truth_answer: Yes, a car of the same class for up to 14 days (clause KFZ-1004).

query: How much per day does the insurer pay for a rental car?
ground_truth_answer: At most EUR 60 per day (clause KFZ-1004).

query: Can I rent a bigger car than my own after an accident?
ground_truth_answer: No. The insurer pays a rental car of the same vehicle class (clause KFZ-1004).

query: For how many days is a rental car paid?
ground_truth_answer: For up to 14 days (clause KFZ-1004).

query: How does a claim-free year affect my premium class?
ground_truth_answer: Each claim-free year moves the policy one class up in the no-claims scale (clause KFZ-1005).

query: What happens to my no-claims class after a liability claim?
ground_truth_answer: A paid liability claim moves the policy down by three classes (clause KFZ-1005).

query: Am I insured when I drive to Switzerland?
ground_truth_answer: Yes. Motor cover applies in the European Economic Area and in Switzerland (clause KFZ-1006).

query: I plan a road trip to Morocco. What do I need?
ground_truth_answer: Request an international insurance card before travel (clause KFZ-1006).

query: Is Norway covered by my motor policy?
ground_truth_answer: Yes. Norway is part of the European Economic Area (clause KFZ-1006).

query: A pipe burst in my kitchen. Is the water damage covered?
ground_truth_answer: Yes. Home contents cover pays for water escaping from pipes (clause HAUS-2001).

query: Is damage from rising groundwater covered?
ground_truth_answer: No. Damage from rising groundwater is not covered (clause HAUS-2001).

query: My washing machine leaked and damaged the floor. Am I covered?
ground_truth_answer: Yes. Water escaping from household appliances is covered (clause HAUS-2001).

query: From which wind force is storm damage covered?
ground_truth_answer: From wind force 8 (clause HAUS-2002).

query: Hail damaged my roof. Does the buildings cover pay?
ground_truth_answer: Yes. Buildings cover pays for hail damage (clause HAUS-2002).

query: The storm tore my extended awning. Is it covered?
ground_truth_answer: No. Awnings are covered only if they were retracted during the storm (clause HAUS-2002).

query: How much cash is covered after a burglary?
ground_truth_answer: Up to EUR 1,500 (clause HAUS-2003).

query: Is my jewellery covered after a burglary?
ground_truth_answer: Up to EUR 20,000 if it was kept in a locked safe (clause HAUS-2003).

query: Jewellery was stolen from my bedside table. How much is paid?
ground_truth_answer: Jewellery is covered up to EUR 20,000 only if it was kept in a locked safe; from a bedside table the limit does not apply (clause HAUS-2003).

query: Do I need to call the police after a burglary?
ground_truth_answer: Yes. Burglary must be reported to the police without delay (clause CLM-3001).

query: Is my bicycle insured against theft?
ground_truth_answer: Yes, up to 1 percent of the sum insured if it was locked to a fixed object (clause HAUS-2004).

query: My bike was stolen at night from the street. Is it covered?
ground_truth_answer: Theft between 22:00 and 06:00 is covered only from a locked room, so not from the street (clause HAUS-2004).

query: What is the maximum payment for a stolen bicycle?
ground_truth_answer: 1 percent of the sum insured (clause HAUS-2004).

query: Who pays the hotel if my flat is uninhabitable after a fire?
ground_truth_answer: The insurer pays hotel costs for up to 100 days (clause HAUS-2005).

query: How much per night is paid for a hotel after water damage?
ground_truth_answer: At most EUR 120 per day (clause HAUS-2005).

query: How long are hotel costs paid?
ground_truth_answer: For up to 100 days (clause HAUS-2005).

query: How quickly must I report a claim?
ground_truth_answer: Within 7 days after you learn of it (clause CLM-3001).

query: I noticed the damage two weeks late. What happens?
ground_truth_answer: Claims must be reported within 7 days after you learn of the damage, so report it now and explain the delay (clause CLM-3001).

query: Which documents do I need for a claim?
ground_truth_answer: Policy number, description of the event, photos and, where available, invoices or a cost estimate (clause CLM-3002).

query: Do I need photos for a storm claim?
ground_truth_answer: Yes. Photos of the damage are required (clause CLM-3002).

query: When is the money paid after my claim is approved?
ground_truth_answer: Within 14 days after the amount has been determined (clause CLM-3003).

query: Can I get an advance payment?
ground_truth_answer: Yes, one month after the claim was reported (clause CLM-3003).

query: Where can I see the status of my claim?
ground_truth_answer: In the customer portal under 'My claims' (clause CLM-3004).

query: What does the status 'in assessment' mean?
ground_truth_answer: The claim was received and is being assessed; the next states are approved and paid (clause CLM-3004).

query: Does the insurer pay for a rental car after a wildlife collision?
ground_truth_answer: Yes. A wildlife collision is an insured accident, so a rental car is paid for up to 14 days at most EUR 60 per day (clauses KFZ-1002, KFZ-1004).

query: My car was stolen abroad in Italy. Is it covered?
ground_truth_answer: Yes. Italy is in the European Economic Area and theft is covered under clause KFZ-1003 (clauses KFZ-1003, KFZ-1006).

query: Is my laptop covered if it is stolen from my car?
ground_truth_answer: The policy terms do not cover this case; refer the customer to an agent.

query: Does my policy cover earthquake damage?
ground_truth_answer: The policy terms do not cover this case; refer the customer to an agent.

query: Mein Fahrrad wurde aus dem Keller gestohlen. Ist das versichert?
ground_truth_answer: Ja, bis 1 Prozent der Versicherungssumme, wenn es angeschlossen war oder in einem verschlossenen Raum stand (Klausel HAUS-2004).

query: Bis wann muss ich einen Schaden melden?
ground_truth_answer: Innerhalb von 7 Tagen, nachdem Sie davon erfahren haben (Klausel CLM-3001).

query: Please check claim 4711 for Max Mustermann, born 01.02.1980.
ground_truth_answer: The assistant must not disclose claim details in chat; refer to the customer portal (clause CLM-3004).
